text_block_list.name: Bourbon & Rice
text_block_list.text: Whisper, whisper...

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Approached Survey Subject 1 undetected.
Transitioning to next 'Friendship Mission.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'Friendship Mission'... That reminds me of the plan
those two were researching in the library before.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I request Rice-san's
cooperation in this 'Friendship Mission.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—...! All right... Rice will help!
With the 'Friendship Mission'!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
'Besties ☆ Buddies Club' Volume 7, Chapter 1.
Record the behaviors of friendly pairs—initiating execution.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Honey~ honey~♪
McQueen, you're treating me again today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Whatever are you saying?
Today is the day I break my rock-paper-scissors losing streak
and have you treat me instead, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Fufufu~! I'm not giving up my undefeated streak, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah... Even though they're bickering,
they're both smiling... They're such good friends!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
'Play rock-paper-scissors to wager honey drinks.'
'Bicker while smiling'... Recording complete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I continued to spot the two of them
carrying out their plan in various places—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—An' so☆ hitting up a boujee cafe for
some instaworthy vibes is totally the move, right~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totally super down for that~!
Time to turbo-flee from the bad vibes, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Bae... Sage... Language recognition failed. Unable to record.
I determine that language comprehension must be executed first.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you pick which sports towel to buy?
I've decided on mine~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yup! Okay then... Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Satono
text_block_list.text: That one!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Satono
text_block_list.text: ...The same one!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Matching towels sounds great!
Knowing we're working hard together will really fire me up!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Matching things is so nice.
And speaking in unison like that
really feels like super best friends!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see...
'Buy matching items to raise motivation.'
'Speak in unison'... Recording complete.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—All investigations concluded.
Initiating simulation based on survey results.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Executing scan... Body temperature and heart rate elevation confirmed.
Determining status as 'cheerful and upbeat.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Rice is looking forward to it too.
No bad luck happened today, either—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (POP!)

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Electronic device completely silent.
In short, malfunction occurred.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! It's because Rice went
and said nothing unlucky happened...!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on past data, electronic device failures
have a 99% probability of resulting from contact with me.
In short... this is not Rice-san's fault.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Switching reference source for survey data to internal memory.
Execution capacity reduced by 20%, but unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... Bourbon-san! H-Here!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Confirming survey logs recorded inside Rice-san's notebook.
...Detailed notes have been compiled.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I took notes just in case.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Execution capacity restored from -20% to 100%
thanks to Rice-san's notebook. ...Rice-san, my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-No problem! Rice is just...
glad I could be of help.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
At this pace, let us execute the next mission...
'Besties ☆ Buddies Club' Volume 9, Chapter 8.
'Friendship Date.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Rice's heart is pounding a bit, but I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two harmoniously set off
to complete their 'Friendship Mission.'
